note: Lee County, VA zones its land (2014 zoning ordinance, districts A-1 through FP), but no public queryable zoning district service was found. The county GIS (leecova.interactivegis.com) is a login/terms-gated viewer, the Mapping & GIS and Zoning Department pages link no zoning service or map file, and the zoning map is described as under review. Towns of Jonesville and Pennington Gap publish only comprehensive plan land use maps. The only ArcGIS parcel layer found (lee_county_va_parcels, services6.arcgis.com) requires a token, so it is not usable.
